Gameplay

NextRTP

Lightweight random-teleport plugin.

Gameplay

  • Random teleport
View on BuiltByBit

What it does

NextRTP is a lightweight random-teleport plugin, and its single stored tag is random teleport. That is the entire recorded scope: send a player somewhere else, chosen at random. ArkFlame files it under Gameplay as the smallest entry in the set — a counterpart to region and teleport-adjacent products rather than a system in its own right.

Compatibility

  • Random teleport

ArkFlame records 1 scope label for NextRTP: Random teleport. Check those against your own environment before you deploy.
